title:
StockInfo Web Development
+ Data-Science Project
description: A web application that fetches, analyzes, and visualizes stock market data, providing downloadable reports and real-time insights.
longDescription: StockInfo WebDev DS Project is a dynamic Flask-based web application that allows users to retrieve historical stock data from Yahoo Finance, analyze it using pandas and Sweetviz, generate HTML and PDF reports, download CSVs, and access a RESTful API for stock information. It integrates data science techniques with web development to provide an interactive and user-friendly platform for financial data analysis.

title: Paylite – Digital Payments & POS System Prototype
description: A full-stack digital payment system with UPI-based transactions, POS billing, inventory management, and merchant dashboards.
longDescription: Paylite is a complete digital payments and POS ecosystem built using Flask and SQLite. It supports UPI-based QR payments, card transactions, merchant KYC verification, real-time transaction logging, inventory-backed POS billing, printable receipts, and user/merchant dashboards. The project focuses on building a realistic fintech flow with proper transaction safety, session handling, and database integrity.
